Twenty source files name `FeatureFlagKey` in an import or type position. I searched the whole tree with a plain-text grep, so this also covers indirect uses such as `Record<FeatureFlagKey, …>` and `readonly FeatureFlagKey[]`.

I left out three other places that mention the name only inside strings:
- `corpus-manifest.json`
- `scripts/manifest-parts/domain.ts`
- `scripts/manifest-parts/lib.ts`

They describe signatures as text rather than using the type.

- **Definition:** `src/types/feature-flag.ts` holds the union itself. It also uses the type for a `key` field and in `FeatureFlagSnapshot = Record<FeatureFlagKey, boolean>`.
- **Exhaustive mappings:** `src/config/feature-flags.ts` has a `Record<FeatureFlagKey, FeatureFlagDefinition>`, so it needs an entry for the new flag. `src/schemas/feature-flag.ts` has a parity check between the zod schema and the union, so it will likely need the new value too.
- **Other users of the type:**
  - `src/types/event.ts`
  - `src/config/plan-limits.ts`
  - `src/config/nav.ts`
  - `src/lib/feature-flags.ts`
  - `src/hooks/flag-context.ts`
  - `src/hooks/use-feature-flag.ts`
  - `src/hooks/command-groups.ts`
  - `src/components/domain/flags/feature-gate.tsx`
  - `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/flags/page.tsx`
  - `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/flags/flag-toggle-list.tsx`

ANSWER: src/types/feature-flag.ts, src/types/event.ts, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/flags/page.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/flags/flag-toggle-list.tsx, src/config/plan-limits.ts, src/config/feature-flags.ts, src/config/nav.ts, src/schemas/feature-flag.ts, src/components/domain/flags/feature-gate.tsx, src/hooks/flag-context.ts, src/hooks/use-feature-flag.ts, src/hooks/command-groups.ts, src/lib/feature-flags.ts
